newsitem.title: PANAMA: Panama consumer prices rise 0.5 pct in October.
newsitem.headline: Panama consumer prices rise 0.5 pct in October.

text.p: Panama's consumer price index rose 0.5 percent in October, compared with a 0.3 percent rise in September and a 0.3 percent decline in October 1995, the office of the Comptroller General said Friday.

The rise in October 1996 brought inflation during the past 12 months to 1.8 percent, compared with 0.8 percent in the year to October 1995. Cumulative inflation for the first 10 months of the year stands at 1.4 percent.
Economists attribute Panama's low inflation primarily to its use of the U.S. dollar as the national currency and its longstanding wage and price control policies.
